title: St. Louis, Springfield and illness back home
summary: After the Louisiana Shakers, Handy went to St. Louis and Springfield, fell sick with stomach trouble, and ran a business at home.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: And then what happened? You came back here from St. Louis? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. You came back from St. Louis, I think you tell them.

No, I left St. Louis and I went to Springfield. I played out in Springfield for six, seven months out there. And I got sick. Matter of fact, I was sick when I went there. And I had to leave Springfield to come back in because I was about dying on my feet up there with my stomach. And I left and come back here. I went back to Pastor Christian and opened up maybe a little business and kept that up for about two, three years. My stomach fell. I started feeling better. I left there and came back over here.
